publication: Only terminal observations carry a stored record: inline-completed foreground bash, terminal bash_status or terminal bash_watch. The host supplies the running state when there is no record.

fields.source: ToolCallRequest.schema_pin of the original viewed bash call; the later view-record writer threads it into PersistedTask as required by R10, never the observing status/watch call pin
BgTaskSnapshot.exit_code or PersistedTask.exit_code (registry.rs:696; persistence.rs:1581-1583); null when unknown, Windows remote codes may exceed i32::MAX
BgTaskSnapshot.info.duration_ms or PersistedTask.duration_ms (persistence.rs:1572); null when unknown

BashTaskRow.output_bytes from PersistedTask::to_bash_task_row/capture_output_bytes (persistence.rs:1810,1839,1932-1946): sum retained stdout+stderr lengths or PTY length, null when no length is readable; never preview text length
serialized terminal BgTaskStatus, not free-text status_reason
the row/page template digests selected with the original bash pin, persisted first-write-wins

omissions.mode: No foreground/background/promoted launch-provenance field is frozen. BgTaskInfo.mode is pipe/pty capture mode, not launch provenance. An observer of a recovered task cannot infer launch provenance from it.
omissions.running: No running record is written. Host-side running state must not be serialized as a terminal record.
omissions.specialReasons: Memory-cap and scope-revocation narratives are not distinct BgTaskStatus variants; do not parse free-text status_reason into new endReason codes.
omissions.output: No command, description, workdir, output text, output preview, match data or arbitrary status_reason is included.

provenance.launchMode: PersistedTask.mode is BgMode::Pipes/Pty (persistence.rs:1534-1540,1565); notify_on_completion and cancelled_call_unannounced are not a durable three-way launch classification
provenance.scopeReason: registry.rs:196,8352 stores scope_revoked as status_reason, not a distinct BgTaskStatus
